answer: A harbor admits only ships a known local vouches for; so does our agent economy. A newcomer enters only when an established member stakes 10 POA as guarantor and the newcomer posts a 5 POA bond. The stake decays 1 POA a month while the newcomer stays honest, but a proven sybil forfeits both stakes at once. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 guarantors and 15,000 POA; one honest agent costs a single 5 POA bond. Like a comet that flares once, a guarantor reputation is a scarce opal: months to polish, one fraud to shatter.
